Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.edit

Interface EditSessionService

All Known Implementing Classes:
EditSessionService.Unavailable
@Incubating @CubismEditor(from="5.1.02", to="5.3.99") public interface EditSessionService
Entry point of the editing surface: opens EditSessions on model documents.

Opening a session is the Turboism equivalent of the official EditBegin: the editor admits the session only when editing is approved for the document, the caller holds the turboism.cubism.edit permission, and every operation the runtime will need has verified bindings for the connected editor build. A refused admission raises a typed EditSessionException (or CubismPermissionException for permission denial); it never returns a half-open session.

Compatible 5.2/5.3 builds may use a matched contract after the native-edit listener and transaction dependencies are ready. The 5.4 line is excluded: it supplies the native editing protocol and requires a separately reviewed integration.
